_comment: Tool registry for the flagship_v3 cognitive-core post-training (idea #4). Single source of truth: consumed by scripts/gen_teacher_data.py (data), src/tool_data.py (SFT formatting), src/grammar.py (constrained decoding) and scripts/tool_eval.py (eval). Response protocol is a mode discriminator followed by content: 'TOOL {json}' for a call, 'ANSWER <text>' for a direct reply. Types: string | number | enum.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Look up current events or factual information on the web.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert a value from one unit to another.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a location.

tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Get the current time in a timezone.

tools.name: define
tools.description: Look up the definition of a word or term.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder at a given time.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a contact.
